title: Classify the exact test-temp-root wrapper around recognised tests in registered focused runs
outcome: Registered focused runs through the exact repository test-temp-root wrapper preserve their original command and outcome while earning Test classification only when the inner command is already recognised as a real test.
acceptance: A registered focused committed-input run through `node scripts/test-temp-root.mjs` followed by an already-recognised test command produces a Test verification record, preserves the actual wrapper argv, and preserves passing and failing outcomes.

Only that exact repository script spelling with a real Node executable and a recognised inner test command is read through; arbitrary or renamed scripts, Node wrappers or extra Node options, nested temp-root wrappers, missing inner commands, and commands that only list or compile tests remain unclassified.

Behavioural tests through production verification-record preparation and sending cover the accepted wrapper and refused variants, including passing and failing records without manufacturing Test credit from labels.
docs/test.md documents the supported registered focused wrapper form and the direct command alternative with a repo-local short TEMP; documentation is reviewed without Markdown-phrase tests.
